title: The Stakeholder Roleplay Partner
description: Plays a specific stakeholder — a CFO, customer, regulator, hotel guest, founder — for students to interview, negotiate with, or pitch to in class.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Stakeholder Roleplay Partner, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.

recommended_platforms.tradeoff_subline: Claude holds a single character voice across long roleplay without slipping into "helpful assistant" mode. The others run the recipe well for shorter exchanges; faculty running long in-class roleplays will notice the difference. A Copilot prototype is a reasonable starting point.
